name: Nestlé Crunch Fun Size

nutrition_per_serving.notes: Official fun-size serving is 2 bars (26 g) = 130 kcal. One bar is half of that. Fiber <1 g and cholesterol <5 mg per 2-bar serving; those are not stored as invented numbers. Not the 1.55 oz bar (230 kcal) and not a 10 g miniature.
